newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish consumer confidence rises in January.
newsitem.headline: Finnish consumer confidence rises in January.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence rose to 15.5 points in January from 13.8 points in December, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
The consumer confidence index rose to a new record in January, SF said.
"Finnish consumers have been already for some time the most optimistic consumers within the EU countries," it said.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: personal finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
The consumer confidence indicator was 13.8 points in November, 14.2 points in September, 12.9 in August, 10.9 in July, 9.8 in June, 7.0 in May and 4.5 in April after falling from 6.1 points in March.
